useQuery L41-47 ported verbatim: queryKey ['system-status','anomalies-summary', firstVehicleId]; queryFn ({signal}) => request<AnomalyData>(`/analytics/anomalies?vehicle_id=${firstVehicleId}&days=1`, {signal}) with snake_case vehicle_id + days=1 preserved exactly; enabled: firstVehicleId !== null; staleTime: STALE_TIMES.SLOW. useQuery<AnomalyData> generic kept.

Early returns L49-52 preserved: `if (!data || data.anomalies_last_24h === 0) return null;` then `const top = data.anomalies?.[0]; if (!top) return null;`. Web used data.anomalies[0]; the native `?.` is a safe superset (undefined -> top falsy -> null), matching the 'render nothing when no anomalies' contract.

summary string L54 ported byte-for-byte: `${data.anomalies_last_24h} in 24h · ${top.signal} ${formatRelative(top.detected_at)}` including the U+00B7 middot and the literal ' in 24h'. No i18n in the source (no useTranslation), so the literal label 'Anomalies' and the formatter strings are kept verbatim.

Return/HealthRow L56-64 -> inline native HealthRow with the SAME props the web caller passed: status={SEVERITY_TO_STATUS[top.severity]}, icon (Activity glyph), label='Anomalies', summary, to='/anomaly-detection'. The web HealthRow render is reproduced with RN primitives: a status-colored dot (View), a decorative icon-glyph slot, a truncating label (numberOfLines=1, text-sm/medium, --text-primary), a status-colored summary (text-xs), and a trailing chevron when `to` is set. The full 5-status DOT_FOR_STATUS/TEXT_FOR_STATUS color map from the web HealthRow (green/amber/red/zinc/blue-400) is preserved exactly; row metrics mirror web (gap-3->12, px-3/py-3->12, rounded-lg->8, min-h-[44px]->minHeight 44).

Navigation: web HealthRow `to` renders a react-router <Link>; native funnels onPress to a useNativeNavigateFallback() no-op (mirrors AlertRulesPage port) while preserving the '/anomaly-detection' target on accessibilityHint and an accessibilityLabel of `${label} — ${summary}` (web HealthRow aria-label). The dot and icon are marked decorative (accessibilityElementsHidden) like the web aria-hidden spans. L65 closing brace preserved.

Browser-only behaviour: none beyond router navigation (handled by the documented native-safe fallback); no other unavailable state required. Output imports only react, react-native (Pressable/StyleSheet/View), @tanstack/react-query, the native client/hooks/SemanticIcon/AppText, and theme colors.
